quote: "Set sail on a ten-day voyage aboard Aliikai through Raja Ampat's legendary reefs and wild islands."
answer: 10 Day Raja Ampat North is a ten-day voyage aboard Aliikai, a handcrafted phinisi, from Sorong through Indonesia's Raja Ampat: the Kri peninsula, the Passage, Penemu, Wayag, Wofoh, Arborek's mantas, Mansuar and the waterfalls of Batanta. Diving and snorkelling with Nitrox, kayaks, all meals and park fees are included. Fixed departures sail in 2027 and 2028.

days.title: Sorong
days.body: Met at Sorong airport by the crew and taken to the harbour, a twenty-minute drive. Settle in, lunch on deck and sail for the islands. If time allows, a first snorkel or check dive, then sundowners and dinner under the stars.
days.imgAlt: Photo placeholder: Photo · Aliikai At Sorong

days.title: Kri Peninsula
days.body: Wake to the calls of tropical birds. Snorkel the mangroves of Mioskon Bay or kayak its mirrored water; the Kri peninsula has some of the finest underwater views in Raja Ampat. Nearby Mansuar has a village worth a first visit.

days.title: The Passage
days.line: Birds of paradise and Kabui Bay
days.body: Up at dawn for the best chance of the rare Red Bird of Paradise, with the cruise director leading the hike to the platform. After breakfast, the mushroom islands of Kabui Bay and the narrow saltwater channel where the current carries coral and fish.
days.acts: Bird of paradise hike · Kabui Bay

days.title: Penemu Islands
days.body: Limestone domes draped in green around a shallow bay, with a trail to the panoramic lookout. The water here holds some of the best snorkelling and diving in the area: sea turtles, manta rays and big schools of fish.

days.title: Wayag Islands
days.body: A maze of green peaks rising from blue water, the landscape Raja Ampat is known for. Climb the island peak for the view, or take the day on a deserted beach. Both are made for sunset.

days.title: Wofoh Islands
days.body: Two islands joined by a shallow reef, for beachcombing, paddleboarding and kayaking. Wofoh also has a coral wall that drops into clear blue water, alive with sponges and soft and hard corals.
days.imgAlt: Photo placeholder: Photo · Wofoh Coral Wall

days.title: Arborek
days.body: The waters off Arborek, where manta rays gather to feed on the plankton carried in by the Dampier Strait tides. Dive or snorkel over the sand to watch them, then go ashore to Arborek, one of Raja Ampat's few villages.
days.imgAlt: Photo placeholder: Photo · Manta At Arborek

days.title: Mansuar Island
days.body: Snorkelling and diving with turtles and manta rays off Mansuar, then ashore to a village to learn about daily life here. Sundowners as Aliikai sails on toward Batanta.

days.title: Batanta & Dayang
days.body: Batanta, the smallest of Raja Ampat's four main islands. After breakfast, a trek along the north coast to two jungle waterfalls, then back aboard for a last evening at anchor.

days.title: Sorong
days.body: A last breakfast on deck, the short crossing to Sorong and the crew's farewell. Airport transfers meet your onward flight; most guests break the journey in Bali or continue to a land stay in Sumba.
days.acts: Disembark · onward to Bali or Sumba
days.imgAlt: Photo placeholder: Photo · Farewell On Deck

vessel.title: Aliikai, in detail
vessel.name: Aliikai
vessel.blurb: A traditional phinisi hand-built and refitted in 2020 by more than a dozen carpenters in Bulukumba, South Sulawesi, where these boats have been built for centuries. Seven cabins over three decks, a lounge and dining room, a sky deck and an alfresco deck, with a crew of twelve and an expedition leader.
facts: Traditional phinisi, hand-built in Bulukumba, South Sulawesi
7 across 3 decks, all en-suite with air conditioning
Up to 14 on shared voyages · up to 15 on a private charter
12 Indonesian crew and an expedition leader
Full dive centre with Nitrox, a warm shower for night dives and a ventilated camera room

founder.title: Sailed before it was filed
founder.p1: James sailed Raja Ampat aboard Aliikai in November 2024. The route on this page is the one he would book again.
founder.p2: Fixed departures suit couples, families and solo explorers; private charters can redraw the days around your group.
founder.film: Founder's film · Aliikai, Raja Ampat [VIDEO TO RECORD]

faqs: From US$7,650 per person for the 9 nights in an ocean-view cabin with portholes (2027 published rate, double occupancy), plus 11% tax. Deluxe ocean-view cabins with windows are US$8,910 and the owner's cabins with private balconies US$10,350. All meals, guided diving and snorkelling, water sports and Sorong transfers are included. Travelling solo, the single supplement is 50% of the nightly rate.
When is the best time to sail Raja Ampat?
October to April, when the seas are calmest and the visibility is at its best. In 2027 this route sails on 22 February, 11 and 21 November and 20 December.

Yes. Every cabin takes two, the Asmat bow cabin takes a third on a sofa bed, and the king and queen beds in the upper cabins convert to twins. A larger family can charter the whole yacht for up to 15 guests [confirm minimum ages for diving].
Is a Raja Ampat liveaboard good for non-divers?
No. Snorkelling, kayaking and paddleboarding are part of every day. Diving is guided for certified divers [confirm courses aboard].
Fixed departures run the route above. A private charter of the whole vessel can redraw the days around your group.
Where do we fly in and out?
Sorong, in West Papua. Most guests connect through Jakarta, Makassar or Bali and break the journey in Bali on the way home.

ctaline: Departure dates for 2027 and 2028 are coming soon. Ask to be first to hear, or about chartering the whole vessel. Text James on 561.479.6355.

experiences.name: Mantas at Arborek
experiences.body: The Dampier Strait tides bring the plankton, and the mantas come to the cleaning stations to feed. Divers wait on the sand; snorkellers watch from the surface.
experiences.james: The only traffic jam in Raja Ampat is mantas. I waited in it happily, twice.

experiences.name: The Wayag peak
experiences.body: A short, steep climb to the lookout over the green karst islands, the view Raja Ampat is known for. Go early or at golden hour.

experiences.name: Red Bird of Paradise at dawn
experiences.body: Up before the sun for a walk to the viewing platform, where the males display in the canopy.

experiences.name: Guided diving with Nitrox
experiences.body: Up to [number] guided dives a day on reefs, walls and channels, with Nitrox aboard. Equipment rental and courses on request.

experiences.name: Snorkelling, kayaks and paddleboards
experiences.body: Calm, clear lagoons for every level, with kayaks and paddleboards launched from the ship whenever you like.

experiences.name: Village visits
experiences.body: Ashore with the crew to meet the communities who look after these reefs.

experiences.name: Waterfalls of Batanta
experiences.body: A trek along the north coast of Batanta to two cold pools under the falls.

dep_season: Raja Ampat season runs October to April, when the seas are calmest. Aliikai spends the middle of the year in Komodo and the Spice Islands.
dep_note: Shared voyages are priced per person, double occupancy, plus 11% tax. Or charter the whole yacht (up to 15 guests): US$10,900 a night plus 11% tax, minimum 7 nights in Raja Ampat (3 in Komodo).
